index 0000000..07735e9

@@ -0,0 +1,56 @@
+# This file is part of Ansible
+#
+# Ansible is free software: you can redistribute it and/or modify
+# it under the terms of the GNU General Public License as published by
+# the Free Software Foundation, either version 3 of the License, or
+# (at your option) any later version.
+
+from __future__ import (absolute_import, division, print_function)
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+import pytest
+
+from units.compat.mock import Mock
+
+from ansible.module_utils.facts.hardware.aix import AIXHardware
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('smt_output, threads', [
+    ('smt_threads 4 SMT threads per processor False\n', 4),
+    ('', 1),
+])
+def test_get_cpu_facts(smt_output, threads):
+    devices = ''.join('proc%s Available 00-00 Processor\n' % i for i in range(12))
+    module = Mock()
+    module.run_command.side_effect = [
+        (0, devices, ''),
+        (0, 'type PowerPC_POWER7 Processor type False\n', ''),
+        (0, smt_output, ''),
+    ]
+
+    facts = AIXHardware(module).get_cpu_facts()
+
+    assert facts == {
+        'processor': ['PowerPC_POWER7'],
+        'processor_count': 1,
+        'processor_cores': 12,
+        'processor_threads_per_core': threads,
+        'processor_vcpus': 12 * threads,
+    }
+    assert module.run_command.call_count == 3
+
+
+def test_get_cpu_facts_without_available_processors():
+    module = Mock()
+    module.run_command.return_value = (0, 'proc0 Defined 00-00 Processor\n', '')
+
+    facts = AIXHardware(module).get_cpu_facts()
+
+    assert facts == {
+        'processor': [],
+        'processor_count': 1,
+        'processor_cores': 0,
+        'processor_threads_per_core': 1,
+        'processor_vcpus': 0,
+    }
+    module.run_command.assert_called_once_with('/usr/sbin/lsdev -Cc processor')
